title: Whole-Plasmid Sequencing Send-out (Plasmidsaurus)
author: Raven Coffer
materials: Return samples to the proper storage location.

steps.title: Determine Sequencing Service and Calculate Dilutions
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate Plasmidsaurus service based on plasmid size and concentration using Table 1 and calculate required dilutions using the TEMPLATE_Plasmidsaurus_SEQ.xlsx spreadsheet.

substeps.instruction: Choose service from Table 1: Standard Low Concentration (20-200 ng/uL, 10 uL), Standard High Concentration (200-1000 ng/uL, 4 uL), Big (25-125 kb, 50-400 ng/uL, 20 uL), or Huge (125-300 kb, 50-400 ng/uL, 40 uL).
Guideline for Standard: Select High Concentration if all samples > 200 ng/uL; otherwise, select Low Concentration.

On the spreadsheet Part 1: Highlight the row for the pre-determined sequencing sample type based on Table 2 (Standard Low: 30 ng/uL, 15 uL; Standard High: 250 ng/uL, 6 uL; Big: 100 ng/uL, 25 uL; Huge: 100 ng/uL, 45 uL).
On the spreadsheet Part 2: Fill grey boxes with the recommended concentration and volume from Table 2.
On the spreadsheet Part 3: Input sample IDs and concentrations into yellow boxes.

For samples below recommended concentration but above minimum required: Manually edit the row to show 0 uL nuclease-free water (blue box) and the recommended volume of sample (purple box) equal to the recommended volume for that sequencing type.
Save and upload the edited spreadsheet for record-keeping.

steps.title: Prepare and Label Tubes
steps.instruction: Label and prepare microcentrifuge tubes according to the sample order in the spreadsheet.

substeps.instruction: Number microcentrifuge tubes starting at '1' up to the total number of samples.
Label tube #1 (and the first tube of each additional strip) with the first 2 letters of the order code.

steps.title: Dilute Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute each sample individually to the recommended concentration as calculated by the spreadsheet.

substeps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of nuclease-free water to each tube first.
Add the calculated volume of the respective sample to the correct tube.

steps.title: Mix and Spin Samples
steps.instruction: Ensure samples are homogeneous and collected at the bottom of the tubes.

substeps.instruction: Securely close the caps on the microcentrifuge tubes.
Vortex for 3-5 seconds.
Spin down using a benchtop centrifuge for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Place Order Online
steps.instruction: Submit the sequencing order through the Plasmidsaurus portal.

substeps.instruction: Login to the DAMP Lab account on Plasmidsaurus.
Select 'Plasmid' and the sequencing type determined in Step 1.1.
Input the order name (date, project, and initials).
Paste sample names from the spreadsheet into the sample names box.
Click 'review order'.
Select a dropoff box (DAMP Lab usually selects #573).
Choose 'Dinocoins' as payment; notify Lab Manager if balance is insufficient.
Enter relevant personnel emails in the 'Share Results' section.
Click 'Place order' and print the order form.

steps.title: Package Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the samples and documentation for transport.

substeps.instruction: Place microcentrifuge strip-tubes into a 50 mL conical tube with a few kimwipes for padding.
Place the conical tube into a bag containing the printed order sheet, folded so the QR code is visible.
Seal the bag securely.

steps.title: Submit Samples and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Deliver the samples to the drop-off location and sanitize the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample bag in the determined dropbox prior to the daily pickup time.
Wipe benches and pipettes with DNAaway and RNase Aaway.
Wipe benches and pipettes again with 70% ethanol.
